Du willst Ergebnisse, keine Diskussionen?
Du arbeitest strukturiert, hast ein klares Verständnis für saubere Prozesse und weißt, wie wichtig Verlässlichkeit im Vertrieb ist? Dann bist du bei uns genau richtig!
Wir suchen einen Senior Sales Consultant (m/w/d), der mit klarem Fokus auf Abschlussquote, Systemtreue und messbare Resultate arbeitet. In dieser Position übernimmst du Verantwortung für die direkte Kundengewinnung, führst strukturierte Verkaufsgespräche anhand erprobter Leitfäden und unterstützt beim Ausbau unserer Vertriebsprozesse. Visionen überlassen wir anderen, du bringst Klarheit, Kontrolle und Umsetzung.
Deine Aufgaben
Kundengewinnung mit Struktur: Gezielte Ansprache potenzieller Kunden, Bedarfsanalyse und Führung durch unseren klar definierten Vertriebsprozess.
Pflege stabiler Kundenbeziehungen: Saubere Betreuung mit nachvollziehbaren Abläufen, festen Schritten und dokumentierten Follow-ups.
Vertriebsprozesse umsetzen: Einhaltung von Standards, Arbeit mit KPIs und Sicherstellung, dass kein Schritt ausgelassen wird.
Teamverantwortung übernehmen: Enge Zusammenarbeit mit dem Team, klare Übergaben und Orientierung durch feste Strukturen.
Was wir dir bieten
Stabilität & Klarheit: Strukturierte Prozesse, feste Zuständigkeiten und ein durchdachtes Vertriebssystem.
Arbeitsplatz mit Planbarkeit: Geregelte Abläufe, messbare Ergebnisse und ein klarer Erwartungshorizont.
Modernes Büro in Freiburg: Konzentrationsfördernde Umgebung mit klarer Aufgabentrennung und ruhiger Atmosphäre.
Strukturiertes Onboarding: Systematische Einarbeitung, Schritt für Schritt.
Teamorientierte Umsetzung: Jeder kennt seinen Bereich, alles greift ineinander, ohne Reibungsverluste.
Mehrjährige Vertriebserfahrung, idealerweise im Beratungs- oder Agenturumfeld.
Freude an Zielen, Zahlen und dem sichtbaren Erfolg von klaren Abläufen.
Unternehmerisches Denken, strukturierte Umsetzung und eigenverantwortliches Handeln.
Klare Kommunikation in Deutsch und Englisch, sachlich, effizient, ohne Umwege.
Führung mit Struktur, nicht mit Vision, sondern mit System.

Ampa is a pioneering neurotechnology startup developing brain stimulation technology to help eradicate depression . We will improve millions of lives by making this transformative treatment universally accessible. Joining us means you’ll be part of a rapidly growing startup with significant equity opportunities and a major impact on our future.

What to Expect: Working at Ampa is a rare chance to help transform global mental health and save millions of lives — a level of impact that demands deep commitment. Success here requires resilience, adaptability, and the discipline to put in long hours.

If you thrive in a high-intensity, fast-changing environment and want your work to truly matter, you may do the best work of your life here. Role Overview: Ampa is hiring our first dedicated full cycle sales representative to sell our TMS system to psychiatrists, clinic owners, and mental health practices across the US.

You will own the entire sales motion, from generating your own pipeline to running demos to closing deals. This is high-ticket capital equipment subscription to physician decision-makers, and you will work directly with our founding team as we scale a proven product into a growing market.

Key Responsibilities: Own the full sales cycle: prospect, qualify, demo, negotiate, close, and deposit collection Generate your own pipeline through outbound prospecting, referrals, and creative channel development Deliver compelling product demos to psychiatrists and clinic owners, both virtual and in person Build and maintain long-term relationships with clinical customers to facilitate upsells Partner closely with our founding executive team on strategy, positioning, and high-value deals Maintain accurate pipeline data and forecasting in our CRM Share market and customer feedback with product and marketing to sharpen our go-to-market What We’re Looking For: 5+ years of full cycle sales experience, with a track record of hunting and closing your own deals Experience selling high-ticket capital equipment or subscription to physician-owned clinics, ideally in medical devices, medtech, or adjacent markets Verifiable quota attainment.

You should be able to walk us through the specific deals that got you to your number Proven ability to break into new accounts and build channels from scratch, without relying on the infrastructure of a large company Consultative, substance-first selling style.

Our buyers are psychiatrists who respond to clinical credibility, ROI clarity, and intelligence Comfort with long sales cycles and cash-pay ROI conversations with practice owners Startup mindset: resourceful, persistent, and energized by ambiguity Why Join Ampa? Impact: Lead the growth of transformative mental health technologies.

Growth: Thrive in a startup environment with rapid innovation. Stability: Enjoy startup benefits with a secure product line. Ownership: Receive substantial equity as an early team member. Logistics: Work Mode: Remote Location: US Employment: Full-time Originally posted on Himalayas

Sales Development Representative PayTrace - Remote The Sales Development Representative (SDR) is a crucial part of the lead generation and sales process within PayTrace and is responsible for generating leads for our Account Executive team.

The SDR will be assigned various targeted lists for outbound cold calling, developing a pipeline and generating new opportunities for sales. What you'll do: Drive top-of-the-funnel lead generation for account executives. Manage leads through the sales pipeline by setting appointments, following up on leads, and tracking progress towards sales goals.

Update and manage all sales activities, opportunities, and account information in CRM. Generate new business pipeline through outbound prospecting, cold calling, and email campaigns.

Earn commissions by exceeding KPI’s - including outbound activity (phone/email/social messages), the number of appointments set, monthly and quarterly opportunities generated, etc.

Establish active communication and engagement with prospects to create new leads and sales opportunities Deliver high-quality professional service consistent with our core values. Stay up-to-date on market trends, industry developments, and competition. Overcome objections and communicate persuasively and effectively.

Collaborate with sales and marketing to build strategies for generating new prospects. What we need from you: High school diploma or GED. Minimum 2 years relevant work experience for SaaS company. Minimum 2 years experience in cold calling and generating new leads.

Proven record of success with developing prospecting lists and meeting or exceeding targets. Experience in the Payment Industry, SaaS, or B2B experience.

Ability to work independently with limited direction in a fast-paced environment Strong presentation and communication skills in person, via phone or online or via email with customers and prospects. Highly organized with the ability to multitask, prioritize deadlines, manage time efficiently and track data.

Demonstrated ability to meet or exceed quotas. Previous experience selling datacenter or Database-focused solutions are a plus. Prior experience with HubSpot, Zoominfo, Outreach, Slack, Google Suite, LinkedIn and other sales and marketing tools are a plus. Excellent written and verbal communication skills. A desire to learn and grow.

A collaborative spirit with excellent cross-functional working skills. Travel Requirements: Under 10% Salary range: $40,000-$55,000 base plus incentive plan. Pay within this range varies by work location and on job-related knowledge, skills, and experience.

We look forward to discussing your salary expectations and our full total rewards offerings throughout the interview process. Who we are: PayTrace by North, your B2B payments experts, transforms financial and accounting processes to future-proof your business.

With advanced payment automation solutions and a user-friendly API, they help B2B companies become more efficient, successful, and profitable. Processing more than $48 billion in payment transactions, PayTrace is committed to providing easy-to-use payment solutions and merchant services, with built-in PCI compliance and security, and 5-star service.

At North, we celebrate diversity and create an inclusive environment for everyone. We are an equal-opportunity employer. To learn more about North and our family of companies, visit our website: https://www.north.com/company/about/our-companies-brands Originally posted on Himalayas

## About Outsite
Outsite is a global coliving company for remote workers — hotel-quality service, extended-stay flexibility, and a built-in community, at the intersection of hospitality and lifestyle. We operate 40+ properties across 21+ cities on 5 continents, with 6,000+ verified members and an NPS of 65.
## About Outsite for Teams
Outsite for Teams is Outsite's B2B expansion — giving companies, teams, and communities access to our global network of coliving and coworking spaces for their employees. Rather than a bulk discount, we position it as a meaningful perk: founders and leaders purchase memberships on behalf of their team, and a dedicated account manager keeps them active and engaged. This is a genuine growth priority for the business, and you'll be one of the first dedicated sales hires driving it.

We're hiring a Business Development Representative to build and run outbound sales for Outsite for Teams. You'll identify and prospect the right companies, run discovery calls, and close new business — turning remote-first startups, distributed teams, and growth-stage companies into long-term Outsite for Teams accounts.
This is a highly autonomous, build-it-yourself role. You'll help shape the outbound playbook, not just execute someone else's.

### 1. Prospecting & Outbound
· Build and work target lists of remote-first and hybrid companies, using signals like team size (50–500), remote/hybrid language in company descriptions, and titles such as Head of People, Chief of Staff, VP of Operations, or Founder
· Source leads via LinkedIn Sales Navigator, Wellfound/AngelList, Crunchbase, remote job boards (We Work Remotely, Remote.co), and Outsite's own member base
· Run cold outbound via email, LinkedIn, and calls, and continuously test and refine messaging
· Reach out to local companies near Outsite locations to sell business travel and corporate stay packages
· Build partnerships with travel agencies and tour operators to generate referral and bundled-stay opportunities
### 2. Sales & Pipeline Management
· Run discovery calls to understand a prospect's team, travel patterns, and remote work culture
· Own the full sales cycle from first touch to close
· Keep the CRM clean and current — every deal staged, every next step logged
· Forecast pipeline accurately and hit monthly/quarterly new business targets
### 3. Collaboration & Handoff
· Partner with the Head of Marketing on positioning, collateral, and campaigns that support outbound
· Hand off closed accounts cleanly to the account management side, with full context on the client's goals
· Share market feedback — what's resonating, what isn't — to sharpen Outsite for Teams' pitch and ICP over time
### 4. Reporting
· Report weekly on pipeline: volume, stage, conversion, and blockers
· Track and share what's working in outbound so it can be systematized

· 1+ years of B2B sales or business development experience (SDR/BDR background a plus)
· Confident, consultative communicator — comfortable running discovery calls with founders and People leaders
· Self-starter who's built pipeline from scratch, not just worked warm leads
· Able to work autonomously and independently
· Comfortable with taking initiative and being proactive
· Comfortable working European timezone hours
· Strong written communication — outbound copy is part of the job
· Organized; keeps a CRM honest without being told to
· Comfortable using AI in workflow

· Experience selling to remote-first or distributed teams
· Familiarity with Pipedrive or HubSpot
· Existing network in the startup, remote work, or travel/hospitality space
· Experience selling a membership, subscription, or perk-style product
## What Success Looks Like (First 90 Days)
· A working, documented outbound playbook (lists, messaging, cadence)
· A full and accurately-staged pipeline in the CRM
· First qualified meetings booked and first deals in late-stage or closed
· Clear, weekly reporting rhythm established with Marketing
· Sharpened point of view on which ICPs convert fastest

· Remote, travel encouraged
· Credits for Outsite locations
· Salary - $45,000 - $50,000 USD + commission

About Huzzle At Huzzle, we connect exceptional talent with top opportunities at leading companies across the UK, US, Canada, Europe, and Australia. Our clients include fast-growing startups, digital agencies, SaaS companies, and tech-enabled businesses across industries such as MarTech, FinTech, EdTech, and eCommerce. Unlike traditional outsourcing agencies, we place you directly with innovative companies where you become a valued member of the team.
About the company Our client is a results-driven B2B growth agency that specializes in bridging the gap between brand awareness and sales conversions. Based in the UK with a global reach across major hubs like New York and Dublin, the team provides a sophisticated "go-to-market as a service" model.

They integrate deep market research, creative brand positioning, and demand generation with high-performance SDR teams to build sustainable sales pipelines for scaling B2B businesses. By shifting away from traditional templated outreach, they focus on warming markets and earning prospect trust before a single call is made.
The team prides itself on an intelligence-first methodology, ensuring every campaign is backed by data and high-confidence market insights. Serving innovative founders in the SaaS, FinTech, and professional services sectors, they have a proven track record of generating millions in pipeline value.

This is a collaborative, high-growth environment suited for professionals who value transparency, original research, and the pursuit of meaningful, high-quality sales outcomes over volume-based metrics.
Job Type Full-time
Job Summary We are looking for a high-energy, German-speaking Sales Development Representative to join a premier UK-based B2B lead generation agency. In this role, you won’t just be selling a service; you will be the engine behind the growth of B2B founders globally.

We specialize in turning deep market intelligence into real-world results—meaning you will be booking high-value meetings with pre-warmed prospects who are ready to talk business. This is an opportunity to join a fast-paced, global team where your performance directly impacts the company’s expansion into the DACH market.
Key Responsibilities Execute a high-volume outreach strategy with a minimum of 200 touchpoints per day.
Maintain a balanced multi-channel approach: at least 50% phone-based cold calling, supplemented by personalized email and LinkedIn outreach.
Achieve and exceed a monthly target of 12 outbound meetings booked with qualified prospects.
Identify and qualify leads effectively to ensure high conversion rates from initial contact to booked meeting.
Collaborate with the internal intelligence and creative teams to leverage pre-warmed leads and tailored content.
Manage your pipeline and activity daily using LinkedIn Sales Navigator, Google Workspace, and Slack.
Native-level fluency in German (written and spoken).
Fluency in English (written and spoken).
Proven experience in high-volume Cold Calling and Cold Emailing.

Job Details: Are you a problem-solver who excels at sales? Do you thrive on building relationships? Are you interested in joining a fast-growing team? Rise25 is looking for an Business Development Representative to develop and maintain client accounts and accelerate company growth.

You will also be the primary client contact with Rise25 clients and you will help with implementing our strategy to help clients to get ROI, clients and strategic partnerships using done-for-you podcasts and content marketing.

Job Description: Your primary responsibilities will be conducting discovery calls and market research to generate leads and prospects. You will foster interest and identify and propose solutions to client problems, forging profitable opportunities for business development.

You’ll also be one of our contacts with Rise25 clients and you’ll help with meeting with clients to implement our strategy. This role is perfect for you if you are motivated and rewarded by seeing the results of your contributions.

The right candidate will be a highly structured and process driven team member that can operate effectively in our fast paced and dynamic environment. You will have proven expertise in prioritizing and managing multiple simultaneous projects.

Direct experience in building client relationships, establishing project strategy and deliverables, managing project resources and client expectations are requisites. The ideal person has experience with business development, strategy or sales because you will be giving advice to clients on business development, sales, and referral marketing.

People who would thrive in this position may have the following experience: business development, accountability coaching, business coaching, physical trainer or fitness instructor (you are good at motivating people), or former military background (you are good at following through on a plan and meeting objectives). Key Responsibilities:
Conduct high-level discovery calls with target and prospect accounts
Work from existing leads to build and grow the business.
Research accounts, identify key players, and generate interest through cold discovery calls and email campaigns.
Perform solution-based selling to new prospects.
Utilize your active listening skills to understand and uncover customer needs and business problems to effectively communicate how Rise25 can solve them.
Generate new business opportunities to fuel our pipeline.
Consistently achieve established quotas to ensure revenue and growth objectives.
Be the project leader and primary client contact in managing all phases of the strategy behind the podcast and utilization of the podcast as a tool for business development.
Develop a strong relationship with the client and provide insight and ideas
Develop new business with existing clients and/or identify areas of improvement
Provide leadership and direction for day-to-day project operations and provides guidance to other members of the team (i.e. writers, editors, developers, etc.)

About League
League is one of the fastest-growing technology companies in Canada and the leading healthcare experience platform. Getting healthcare is often the easy part — finishing it is where things fall apart: people book the appointment and skip the follow-up, fill the prescription and stop taking it, get the referral and never make the call.

That gap costs health plans and health systems money, and it costs people their health. League closes that gap — identifying what each person needs to do next, clearing what’s in their way, and getting it done, for the 70 million+ people whose care already runs through our platform. Health plans and health systems trust us to do this at scale.

Organizations like Manulife, SCAN, Geisinger, and Medibank on the payer side, and Baptist and Shoppers Drug Mart on the provider side.

This is a build-your-craft role at the front of League's enterprise motion. You will work alongside two to three Account Directors, prospecting into their assigned book of business as the first point of contact between League and healthcare executives owning digital, member experience, AI initiatives, and innovation across North America.
Your core responsibility is conducting deep account research to map League's value proposition to real organizational challenges, then deploying agentic outreach sequences across email, LinkedIn, and direct calls to create discovery meetings and pipelines.
League is an AI-first company and this role is built that way. You will have the tools to research and sequence at a depth that used to take a team, and the support to keep improving how you use them. Your central mandate is to run League's go-to-market system with rigor, and to make it better from the inside.
What You'll Own
Account research and point of view
Research accounts in your Account Directors' book at the level of their actual business: quality performance, digital and AI roadmaps, recent leadership changes, earnings commentary, public filings and app store reviews.
Map League's value proposition to account-specific challenges to build points of view that drive early engagement.
Bring League executives and subject matter experts into accounts where a peer-level conversation opens a door that a rep cannot.
Outreach and pipeline creation
Build and deploy agentic outreach sequences on League's technology stack, across email, LinkedIn and direct calls.
Generate discovery meetings and pipeline while providing Account Directors with high-context research for first calls.
Support marketing events, campaigns and initiatives where League's prospects are a good fit, and follow up on the interest they generate.
The system itself
Execute the go-to-market system with discipline while refining underlying AI workflows, skills, and agents, and share what works with the rest of the team.
Partner with the Marketing team to analyze and iterate on market messaging.
Keep Salesforce accurate and current, because pipeline decisions above you are made from what you record.
Learn the enterprise sales motion end to end, from first touch through opportunity progression.

Ensure access management is performed in compliance with your role and responsibilities.
Execute League's policies and procedures within your team and engagements.
Notify HR, Legal, Compliance & Security of any incidents, breaches, or policy violations.
Comply with Information Security Policies.

Two+ years of outbound sales experience into large enterprises (ideally healthcare). We are hiring for trajectory, not tenure.
A genuine, organic interest in building a sales development career.
Track record of reaching and engaging executive-level buyers.
Fluency with Claude or other AI-native tools, and evidence you fold them into your day-to-day rather than treating them as an add-on.
Strong written communication.
Real curiosity about healthcare and how it is changing. You do not need to know the US healthcare system on day one; you do need to be the kind of person who goes and learns it.
Experience with long, committee-driven enterprise sales cycles.
Experience working alongside senior sellers on account strategy.
Helpful, not required
Exposure to payers, health systems, benefits administrators or consumer health organizations.
Familiarity with Star Ratings, HEDIS, care gaps, benefits navigation and digital front door.
Experience with Salesforce, sales engagement platforms, Artisan or LinkedIn Sales Navigator.
Experience building your own AI workflows, skills or agents.
How You Work
Beyond the functional bar, this seat calls for a specific way of operating:
You listen as well as you talk. You are comfortable picking up the phone and going outbound, and equally able to sit back, hear what is actually being said, and take it in. Neither mode is a stretch for you.
You keep up. You process new information fast: new market, new structure, new process; and you can hold pace with a team that moves quickly..
You run the play. You buy into the system that has been built for you and execute it with discipline. You surface your ideas rather than quietly launching your own version of the stack.
You grind, then you think. You genuinely enjoy the daily rhythm of the work. Within it, you connect dots and find creative angles that the process alone would not produce.
You do the thing every day. You are consistent and process-oriented. Results here come from showing up the same way every morning.
You are discerning with your time. You will be pulled by several Account Directors at once. You know what to say yes to, what to sequence, and what to push back on.
You ask the hard question. You are supportive and easy to work with, and you still challenge assumptions. This team is optimistic by nature and benefits from someone willing to press constructively.
You are self-directed. When something is unfamiliar, you go read, listen and dig until you can hold your own on it. You share your ideas and learnings with others on the team.
You want to win. You lead yourself, you compete, and you bring the energy to keep up with the people around you.
What Success Looks Like
Meetings that hold. You consistently create discovery meetings with the right executives, and your Account Directors walk in with context they did not have to build themselves.
Pipeline that progresses. Opportunities you source advance past first meeting because you stayed in the account and helped shape qualification.
The system gets sharper. Your AI workflows and sequences improve measurably over your first two quarters, and other people on the team adopt what you built.
You know the market. Within months you can hold a credible conversation about US payer and health system dynamics with someone who does it for a living.
You are trusted with more. You have the fundamentals of the enterprise sales motion under you and a clear path toward owning accounts.

s.h: Who will work well with us

About the Opportunity
Sales Assistant to Senior Partner
David Zwirner seeks a full-time Sales Assistant to work alongside one of the gallery's Senior Partners. The Sales Assistant will fulfill administrative assistant duties as well as liaise with curators, artists, and clients for the Senior Partner.
Superior writing skills, the ability to time manage and meet deadlines, and a thorough working knowledge of contemporary art are required. This position will involve significant contact with artists and long time clients and other art industry professionals therefore discretion and poise are essential. This position may be scheduled Mondays - Fridays or Tuesdays - Saturdays depending on gallery needs.
Candidates must be diligent, extremely organized, and possess excellent time management and communication skills.

s.h: Support Senior Partner with roster of artists
s.t:
Assist with general artist management of artists’ studios and estates, with exhibitions, requests, press, image requests, general studio requests, events, appraisals and artist care.
Monitor all artists’ solo/group exhibitions, both domestic and international, manage checklists and loans.
Support with gallery exhibition planning globally.
Liaise with other gallery staff regarding all aspects of inventory & exhibition management: production, shipping, framing, photography, research, etc.
Create and manage client lists for exhibition previews/dinners, support Director during openings.

s.h: Provide broad sales support to Senior Partner
s.t:
Manage Senior Partner's sales, help create sales offers, coordinate and prepare for client viewings and prepare insurance appraisals.
Conduct post-sale tasks including preparing invoices and coordinating shipping.
Manage the Senior Partner's secondary market consignments, prepare consignment and contract agreements; liaise with clients on cataloging and research materials, and create presentations for client offers and significant works.
Work across departments to ensure secondary market artworks have photography, provenance and all other relevant documentation.

Daily management of Senior Partner’s calendar, agendas, to-do list and help set daily priorities and goals. Prepare travel arrangements, itineraries, appointments and expenses.
Responsible for organising the Senior Partner's inbox, and staying on top of all communication requests.
Liaise frequently with multiple departments within the gallery to oversee projects such as exhibition and art fair booth models, gallery exhibition checklists, online viewing rooms, sales previews, and press packets, among others.

s.h: What we would like you to have
s.t:
2-3 years in an assistant or administrative support role at a gallery.
Experience supporting senior leadership with calendar management and travel itinerary.
Detail oriented with experience in managing upwards.
Strong multi-tasking skills with the ability to prioritize and anticipate needs as well as organisational skills.
Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to work cross-departmentally.
Strong interest in sales.
Passion for and knowledge of contemporary art.

Skills can be developed. Experience can be built. What's harder to teach, and what we pay close attention to, is mindset. The qualifications below are specific to this role. But across every role at ISSA , we're looking for the same kind of person.
Someone who leads with curiosity. Who asks "why do we do it this way?" as a genuine question, not a complaint.
Someone humble enough to know what they don't know, and bold enough to challenge the way things have always been done.
Someone who can advocate hard for an idea and then fully commit when the team goes a different direction.
Someone who takes ownership of their mistakes, shares credit for their wins, and believes the best idea should win regardless of who had it.

s.h: Anything else? Absolutely! Benefits and Perks
s.t:
This is a place where every day we are inspired by our teammates, encouraging each other to be our best. The environment is friendly and upbeat! And we feel it’s important to reward our team with competitive pay and benefits. Here are some of the highlights:
Free Certifications: Who wants to be their best self? WE DO! As an ISSA team member, you have access to our courses and certifications…at no expense! Additionally, you'll receive exclusive discounts on leading products in the fitness industry. Cool, right? Employees can also enroll up to 5 friends/family members each year in our courses...FOR FREE!
Health & Wellness Reimbursement: If our company’s mission is to encourage healthy living, we need to walk the talk and ensure each employee is supported in their wellness journey! Employees can submit fitness purchases (gym membership, fitness equipment, classes) and professional and mental health purchases (personal learning courses, wellness apps, art classes, and more) for reimbursement up to $50/month…$600/year.
Work-Life Synergy: Our Team members start with 3 weeks of PTO each year and can earn up to 6 weeks each year! And everyone at ISSA gets 9 paid national holidays every year...PLUS 1 floating holiday! Work hard, play hard!
Parental Time Off: We support our team members as they grow their families! Eligible employees giving birth can receive up to 12 weeks of paid leave, while other parents welcoming a new child (including partners and adoptive/foster parents) receive up to 6 weeks of paid bonding leave.
Medical, Dental, and Vision Insurance: A key component to living a healthy lifestyle is having access to the care we (and our families) need. We offer 2 medical insurance plans accompanied by Health Savings Account (HSA) and Flexible Savings Account (FSA) options, as well as Dental and Vision coverage. And you don’t have to wait forever! Eligibility begins on the 1st of the month after you start.
Team Building: We may be remote, but we don’t have to be alone! We host a monthly schedule of virtual team activities, town halls, brown bag lunches, and other special events…so many fun ways for us to connect and support one another.
Tools To Do The Job: We ensure you are hooked up with the tools, equipment, and systems you need. We begin the process before your start date, so you are ready to rock ‘n roll on your first day. We also provide a monthly work-from-home allowance!

Zelh is a fast-growing outsourcing company that partners with leading US logistics organizations.
Our mission is to become the most reliable outsourcing partner by delivering consistently high-quality services while building long-term relationships with our clients, employees, and partners. We believe that personal attention, timely communication, continuous improvement, and respect are the foundation of everything we do.
We are looking for a proactive Carrier Sales Representative to support our growing drayage operation. This position is responsible for sourcing, developing, and maintaining relationships with drayage motor carriers throughout the United States while securing competitive capacity for customer shipments.

The Drayage Carrier Sales Representative plays a critical role throughout the shipment lifecycle - from quoting and carrier selection through dispatch, scheduling, execution, accessorial management, and final carrier charge verification.

Source and develop reliable drayage carriers across major U.S. port and rail markets.
Build and maintain strong carrier relationships with dispatchers, owners, and carrier representatives.
Identify carrier capacity by proactively contacting carriers about equipment availability, lane preferences, and market conditions.
Request and negotiate rates for drayage shipments, including linehaul and accessorial charges, while protecting company margins.
Evaluate and select carriers based on pricing, availability, equipment, reliability, and service history.
Secure capacity and cover loads after customer approval, ensuring carriers can meet required pickup and delivery dates.
Coordinate pickup and delivery schedules, including container pulls, appointments, container availability, and Last Free Day (LFD) requirements.
Monitor shipment execution and resolve issues, including carrier delays, appointment problems, equipment shortages, and container availability.
Manage accessorial charges, such as detention, storage, chassis, waiting time, redelivery, and demurrage-related costs, ensuring proper approval and documentation.
Complete shipment closeout, including verifying final carrier charges, collecting required documentation, updating TAI, and ensuring accurate records.

s.h: We're looking for someone who has
s.t:
2+ years of experience in freight brokerage, transportation, logistics, or carrier sales, with prior drayage/intermodal, port, or rail experience.
Strong knowledge of U.S. ports and rail ramps, import/export container movements, container types, chassis requirements, overweight shipments, and drayage accessorials.
Proven experience negotiating carrier rates, securing truck capacity, and working with TMS platforms.
Ability to manage multiple shipments, quotes, carriers, and deadlines simultaneously.
Strong problem-solving skills and ability to make decisions under pressure.
Ability to communicate effectively across Carrier Sales, Track & Trace, Customer Facing, Accounting, and leadership teams.

Qualify opportunities based on business pain, stakeholder fit, urgency, timing, use case, and potential revenue impact, then create clear handoffs to Account Executives.

Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to tailor messaging to different customer personas, business priorities, and levels of seniority.

**Help organisations stay one step ahead of cyber threats **
Cyber attacks are no longer a question of if, but when. While prevention remains important, organisations increasingly rely on their ability to detect threats early, respond effectively, and recover quickly.
At Deloitte, we help some of Switzerland's largest and most critical organisations build and transform their cyber defence capabilities. From designing Cyber Defence Centres and Security Operations Centres to improving incident response, deploying security technologies, and exploring AI-enabled security operations, we help our clients strengthen their resilience against an ever-evolving threat landscape.
If you are passionate about cyber defence, enjoy solving complex challenges, and want to work at the intersection of strategy, operations, and technology, this is the opportunity for you.
**How you can make an impact **
As a Cyber Detect & Respond Advisor, you will work alongside experienced cyber professionals to help clients prepare for, detect, respond to, and recover from cyber threats and attacks.

* Assess and improve cyber defence capabilities, including Security Operations Centres (SOC), Cyber Defence Centres (CDC), Incident Response, Threat Intelligence, Threat Hunting, and Vulnerability Management
* Help clients design practical and effective cyber defence strategies, operating models, governance structures, and transformation roadmaps
* Design, implement, configure, and optimise cyber defence technologies such as SIEM, EDR, NDR, Threat Intelligence, and Vulnerability Management platforms
* Support the development of detection use cases, monitoring capabilities, automation workflows, and security operations processes
* Conduct cyber defence assessments, maturity reviews, and benchmarking exercises to identify improvement opportunities
* Support incident response readiness activities, including playbook development, tabletop exercises, and crisis preparedness initiatives
* Evaluate emerging technologies and help clients understand how innovations such as AI-powered security operations can enhance detection and response capabilities
* Work closely with specialists across Deloitte to deliver integrated cyber security solutions that create measurable value for clients
* Contribute to business development, thought leadership, and the continued growth of Deloitte's Detect & Respond practice

We are looking for curious and motivated professionals who combine technical expertise with a desire to make a real impact. You bring:
* Approximately 5+ years of professional experience in cyber security, cyber defence, security operations, incident response, threat intelligence, cyber engineering, or a related field
* A passion for helping organisations prepare for and respond to cyber threats
* Practical experience in one or more areas such as Security Operations, Incident Response, Threat Intelligence, Threat Hunting, Detection Engineering, Vulnerability Management, Digital Forensics, or Cyber Defence
* Familiarity with technologies such as Microsoft Sentinel, Splunk, XSIAM, CrowdStrike, Microsoft Defender, SentinelOne, Cortex XDR, EDR, NDR, SIEM, or similar solutions
* Understanding of modern threat actors, attack techniques, and cyber defence best practices
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, combined with the ability to communicate effectively with both technical and business stakeholders
* Curiosity, drive, and a desire to continuously learn and develop

* Experience working in a Security Operations Centre (SOC), Cyber Defence Centre (CDC), CSIRT, or Incident Response team
* Exposure to AI-enabled security operations, security automation, detection engineering, or threat validation
* Relevant certifications such as CISSP, GCIH, GCIA, GCFA, SC-200, AZ-500, or equivalent
* University degree in a relevant field (Bachelor's or Master's)
* Fluent English; German and/or French are an advantage
**Your team**
You will join a diverse, international, and highly collaborative team of cyber security professionals who are passionate about helping organisations strengthen their resilience against cyber threats.
What makes our team different is the opportunity to work across the full cyber defence lifecycle. One day you may be helping a client define their future Cyber Defence Centre strategy, the next designing security monitoring capabilities, improving incident response processes, or supporting the implementation of leading security technologies.
We believe that great careers are built through challenging work, continuous learning, and strong support. You will benefit from hands-on experience, dedicated mentoring, professional certifications, and collaboration with experts across Deloitte's global network.
Most importantly, we foster an open and inclusive culture where people are encouraged to bring new ideas, challenge the status quo, and shape the future of cyber defence.
